descriptionByLocale.de:
Im Delivery Team von PostFinance entwickelst du Lösungen im Bereich Digital Assets und verbindest unsere neue Verwahrungslösung mit internen Bankensystemen. Du stellst sicher, dass Datenflüsse zuverlässig funktionieren und Transaktionen mit digitalen Vermögenswerten sicher verarbeitet werden. Mit deinem technischen Know-how schaffst du die Basis für innovative Finanzlösungen. So trägst du dazu bei, die Zukunft von PostFinance aktiv mitzugestalten.

Das kannst du bewirken

- Du entwickelst Backend-Komponenten mit Java und Spring Boot und setzt abgestimmte Entwicklungs-Stories in wartbaren, versionierten Code um

- Du integrierst externe Systeme über APIs und Webhooks und realisierst Schnittstellen zu verschiedenen Systemen

- Du implementierst Datenmapping, Validierungen und Bestandsabgleiche zur Prüfung von Quell- und Zieladressen sowie freigegebenen Adresslisten

- Du stellst eine zuverlässige Verarbeitung durch Fehlerbehandlung, Timeouts, Wiederholungsmechanismen und Schutz vor doppelter Verarbeitung sicher

- Du entwickelst automatisierte Tests, beteiligst dich an Code Reviews und Integrationstests und dokumentierst technische Lösungen und Schnittstellen

- Du unterstützt CI/CD und Deployments auf Kubernetes mit Helm sowie Monitoring und Audit Logging und arbeitest dabei eng mit Architektur, Business Analyse, Security und Betrieb zusammen

Das bringst du mit

- Mehrjährige Praxiserfahrung in der Backend-Entwicklung mit Java und Spring Boot sowie abgeschlossene Informatikausbildung oder gleichwertige Berufserfahrung

- Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit REST-APIs, Webhooks, asynchroner Verarbeitung und Integration verteilter Systeme

- Praxis im Umgang mit Git, CI/CD, automatisierten Tests und containerisierten Anwendungen sowie Kenntnisse in Kubernetes und Helm

- Verständnis für sichere Softwareentwicklung, Authentifizierung, Berechtigungen und den sorgfältigen Umgang mit Secrets und sensiblen Daten

- Strukturierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise sowie Fähigkeit zur verständlichen Vermittlung technischer Themen in Deutsch und Englisch

PostFinance treibt die strategische Modernisierung ihrer CRM-Landschaft voran. Als Architecture Owner verbindest du Technologie und Business: Du durchdringst unsere CRM-Prozesse und gestaltest daraus nachhaltige, sichere, stabile und möglichst einfache technische Lösungen.

Das kannst du bewirken

- Du bildest gemeinsam mit Product Owner und Delivery Team Lead das Leadership-Trio des Delivery Teams CRX.

- Du verantwortest die technische Architektur unseres CRM und entwickelst sie gemeinsam mit dem Team und weiteren Architekturrollen weiter.

- Du übernimmst Verantwortung für einen stabilen und reibungslosen technischen Betrieb und stellst sicher, dass Architektur und Umsetzung die Anforderungen an Verfügbarkeit, Wartbarkeit und Betriebsfähigkeit erfüllen.

- Du setzt dich intensiv mit dem CRM-Business und seinen Geschäftsprozessen auseinander.

- Du reduzierst Komplexität, entwickelst klare Lösungsbilder und vermittelst diese so, dass Stakeholder fundierte Entscheidungen treffen können.

- Du entscheidest mit, wann Standardfunktionalität, Konfiguration, Erweiterung oder Integration die passende Lösung ist.

- Du definierst technische Leitplanken, Architekturprinzipien und Coding Guidelines und stellst deren Anwendung sowie eine hohe Code- und Lösungsqualität sicher.

Das bringst du mit

- Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Senior Developer, Tech Lead oder Software Architect und fundierte Kenntnisse in Software- und Lösungsarchitektur.

- Sehr gutes Verständnis von Clean Code, Softwarequalität, APIs, Integration, Datenmodellen, Security und technischem Betrieb.

- Gute Kenntnisse in JavaScript/TypeScript oder vergleichbaren Technologien und Freude daran, dein technisches Know-how hands-on einzubringen.

- Ein ausgeprägtes Interesse am Business und an Geschäftsprozessen sowie die Bereitschaft, das CRM-Business in der Tiefe zu verstehen.

- Erfahrung mit komplexen Standardsoftware- oder Plattformlösungen ist von Vorteil.

- Fähigkeit, komplexe Zusammenhänge zu strukturieren, zu vereinfachen und verständlich zu vermitteln

Wir begleiten unsere Kundinnen und Kunden bei wichtigen finanziellen Entscheidungen in unterschiedlichen Lebensphasen. Mit unserer Expertise in der Finanzplanung unterstützen wir sie dabei, ihre finanzielle Zukunft vorausschauend zu gestalten. Gemeinsam mit unseren Kundenberater:innen entwickeln wir individuelle Lösungen, stärken die Finanzplanung als festen Bestandteil unseres Beratungsangebots und sorgen für eine ganzheitliche und vertrauensvolle Beratung.

Das kannst du bewirken

- Du analysierst komplexe Kundensituationen und erarbeitest ganzheitliche Finanz-, Vorsorge- und Pensionierungsplanungen mit individuellen Handlungsempfehlungen

- Du begleitest unsere Kundinnen und Kunden sowie selbständig Erwerbende bei wichtigen finanziellen Entscheidungen in den Bereichen Vorsorge, Vermögen, Steuern, Pensionierung und Nachlassplanung

- Du unterstützt unsere Kundenberater:innen in anspruchsvollen Beratungssituationen, bringst deine Fachexpertise gezielt ein und hilfst dabei, Beratungs- und Kundenpotenziale zu erschliessen

- Du stellst eine hohe fachliche Qualität sowie ein konsistentes und kundenzentriertes Beratungserlebnis sicher

- Du engagierst dich bei der Weiterentwicklung von Beratungsansätzen, Fachthemen und Arbeitsinstrumenten und bringst Markt-, Kunden- und Praxiserfahrungen aktiv ein

- Du vertrittst die Finanzplanung an internen und externen Veranstaltungen, stärkst die regionale Verankerung des Angebots und leistest einen Beitrag zur Weiterentwicklung des Finanzplanungsgeschäfts

Das bringst du mit

- Kaufmännische Grundausbildung im Bank-, Versicherungs- oder Finanzbereich sowie eine Weiterbildung als Finanzplaner:in mit eidg. Fachausweis, Finanzplanungs-Expert:in, CFP oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

- Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in der umfassenden Finanzplanung sowie ausgewiesene Expertise in der eigenverantwortlichen Erstellung und Präsentation anspruchsvoller Finanz-, Vorsorge- und Pensionierungsplanungen und der damit verbundenen Kundenberatung

- Fundierte Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Vorsorge, Pensionierung, Vermögensstrukturierung, Steuern und Nachlassplanung

- Erfahrung in der Begleitung komplexer Kundensituationen sowie in der Entwicklung individueller Finanzplanungslösungen

- Freude daran, Kundenbedürfnisse zu erkennen, Potenziale aufzuzeigen und aktiv zum Ausbau der Finanzplanung beizutragen

- Ein gut etabliertes Netzwerk in der Finanzplanung deiner Region sowie ausgeprägte Beratungs-, Kommunikations- und Vernetzungskompetenzen

- Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse, idealerweise ergänzt durch eine weitere Landessprache, sowie die Bereitschaft zu regelmässigen Reisen innerhalb deiner Region

Gemeinsam mit deinem Team stellst du eine erstklassige Beratungsqualität sicher, stärkst die Finanzplanung als festen Bestandteil unseres Beratungsangebots und entwickelst das Geschäftsfeld mit Blick auf zukünftige Kundenbedürfnisse gezielt weiter.

- Du erkennst Markttrends und Kundenbedürfnisse frühzeitig und leitest daraus konkrete Weiterentwicklungen für Angebot, Beratung und Zusammenarbeit ab

- Du repräsentierst die Finanzplanung intern sowie extern und leistest einen aktiven Beitrag zur erfolgreichen Weiterentwicklung des Geschäfts

titleByLocale.fr: Collaborateur/trice Kompetenz-Center Kreditkarten

descriptionByLocale.it:
Nel centro di competenza carte di credito sei il primo punto di contatto per le richieste telefoniche sulle nostre carte di credito. Si accompagnano clienti interni ed esterni dall'apertura alla cessazione e fornire consulenza competente. Con il vostro impegno, contribuite a garantire che PostFinance rimanga un fornitore di servizi finanziari orientato all'innovazione in futuro. In questo modo, si crea fiducia e rafforzare la soddisfazione del cliente in modo sostenibile.

Puoi farlo.

- Risponde alle richieste telefoniche di clienti interni ed esterni: competenti e orientati alla soluzione

- Sei la persona di contatto per varie mutazioni intorno a carte di credito come cancellazioni o limiti

- Supporti i consulenti dei clienti: nelle vendite fisiche in casi complessi

- Accetti i reclami correttamente e trovi soluzioni semplici e pragmatiche

Lo porti con te.

- Formazione commerciale completata con esperienza nel settore dei servizi finanziari e/o nel settore amministrativo

- Rapida comprensione e capacità di orientarsi in un ambiente dinamico

- Divertimento del contatto con il cliente e della competenza nella consulenza per creare un'esperienza positiva del cliente

- Conoscenza completa del tedesco nelle parole e nella scrittura nonché buona conoscenza del francese e/o italiano al livello B2
descriptionByLocale.en:
In the Competence Center Credit Cards you are the first point of contact for telephone inquiries about our credit cards. You accompany internal and external customers from opening to termination and provide competent advice. With your commitment, you contribute to ensuring that PostFinance remains an innovation-driven financial service provider in the future. In this way, you create trust and strengthen customer satisfaction sustainably.

You can do that.

- You answer telephone inquiries from internal and external customers: competent and solution-oriented

- You are the contact person for various mutations around credit cards such as cancellations or limits

- You support customer advisors: in physical sales in complex cases

- You accept complaints properly and find simple, pragmatic solutions

You bring that with you

- Completed basic commercial training with experience in the financial services industry and/or in the administrative sector

- Rapid comprehension and ability to orient in a dynamic environment

- Enjoyment of customer contact and competence in consulting to create a positive customer experience

- Complete knowledge of German in words and writing as well as good knowledge of French and/or Italian at level B2
descriptionByLocale.de:
Im Kompetenz-Center Kreditkarten bist du die erste Anlaufstelle für telefonische Anfragen rund um unsere Kreditkarten. Du begleitest interne und externe Kund:innen von der Eröffnung bis zur Kündigung und stellst eine kompetente Beratung sicher. Mit deinem Einsatz trägst du dazu bei, dass PostFinance auch in Zukunft eine innovationsgetriebene Finanzdienstleisterin bleibt. So schaffst du Vertrauen und stärkst die Kundenzufriedenheit nachhaltig.

Das kannst du bewirken

- Du beantwortest telefonische Anfragen von internen und externen Kund:innen kompetent und lösungsorientiert

- Du bist Ansprechperson für verschiedene Mutationen rund um Kreditkarten wie Kündigungen oder Limiten

- Du unterstützt Kundenberater:innen im physischen Vertrieb bei komplexen Fällen

- Du nimmst Beschwerden sachgerecht entgegen und findest einfache, pragmatische Lösungen

Das bringst du mit

- Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Grundausbildung mit Erfahrung in der Finanzdienstleistungsbranche und/oder im administrativen Bereich

- Schnelle Auffassungsgabe und Fähigkeit zur Orientierung in einem dynamischen Umfeld

- Freude am Kundenkontakt sowie Kompetenz in der Beratung zur Schaffung eines positiven Kundenerlebnisses

- Einwandfreie Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie gute Französisch- und/oder Italienischkenntnisse auf Niveau B2
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Dans le Centre de compétences Cartes de crédit, vous êtes le premier point de contact pour les demandes téléphoniques concernant nos cartes de crédit. Vous accompagnez les clients internes et externes de l'ouverture à la terminaison et vous fournissez des conseils compétents. Avec votre engagement, vous contribuez à faire en sorte que PostFinance demeure un fournisseur de services financiers axé sur l'innovation à l'avenir. De cette façon, vous créez la confiance et renforcez la satisfaction des clients de manière durable.

Tu peux le faire.

- Vous répondez aux demandes téléphoniques de clients internes et externes : compétents et orientés vers la solution

- Vous êtes la personne de contact pour diverses mutations autour des cartes de crédit telles que les annulations ou les limites

- Vous aidez les conseillers clients: dans les ventes physiques dans les cas complexes

- Vous acceptez les plaintes correctement et trouvez des solutions simples et pragmatiques

Apporte ça avec toi.

- Formation commerciale de base complétée avec expérience dans le secteur des services financiers et/ou dans le secteur administratif

- Compréhension rapide et aptitude à s'orienter dans un environnement dynamique

- Profitez du contact client et de la compétence dans le conseil pour créer une expérience client positive

- Connaissance complète de l'allemand en mots et en écriture ainsi que bonne connaissance du français et/ou de l'italien au niveau B2

titleByLocale.fr: Head Ressources Humaines (w/m/d)

descriptionByLocale.it:
Come Capo delle Risorse Umane, si gioca un ruolo decisivo nella definizione del futuro di PostFinance da una prospettiva HR. Human Resources fa parte della divisione Corporate Development & People, nel cui team di gestione partecipi e riferisci direttamente al membro responsabile della gestione. Insieme al vostro team di gestione delle risorse umane, sarete responsabili della strategia HR e creare i prerequisiti umani, culturali e organizzativi per PostFinance per raggiungere i suoi obiettivi strategici e finanziari. Continuerai a sviluppare le Risorse Umane come una funzione moderna, efficiente e orientata al futuro e supporterai efficacemente la gestione e l'intera organizzazione attraverso processi di cambiamento e trasformazione.

Puoi farlo.

- Potrai guidare il reparto Risorse Umane in modo indipendente e sviluppare l'organizzazione HR strategicamente, orientata all'impatto e orientata al futuro, riconoscendo la necessità di azione in una fase iniziale e impostando i tuoi impulsi.

- Sei responsabile per HR Business Partnering, People Attraction, HR Advisory, Sviluppo organizzativo e HR Business Excellence e garantire la loro interazione efficace.

- Sei responsabile della strategia delle risorse umane e assicurati che le risorse umane contribuiscano significativamente al raggiungimento degli obiettivi strategici e finanziari delle imprese

- Continuerai a plasmare temi chiave dell'HR lungo l'intero ciclo di vita dei dipendenti, dal reclutamento e dallo sviluppo dei dipendenti alla gestione del talento e della successione alla gestione delle prestazioni e della compensazione.

- Si adattano costantemente i servizi HR alle esigenze dell'organizzazione e garantiscono processi efficienti, sistemi moderni e alta qualità dei servizi

- Si consiglia come partner risparmiatore: nell'Amministratore Delegato e nella gestione delle questioni strategiche delle risorse umane e raggiungere insieme con le HR Business Partners:in vigore nello sviluppo organizzativo, nella pianificazione di successione e nella gestione dei cambiamenti

- Condurrà la cooperazione e i negoziati con le parti sociali e con il Gruppo, in particolare su GAV e questioni salariali

Lo porti con te.

- Laurea universitaria o istruzione superiore nell'amministrazione aziendale, integrata idealmente da un'ulteriore istruzione nella gestione generale o risorse umane

- Diversi anni di esperienza collaudata nella gestione delle risorse umane e in una funzione di leadership impegnativa, tra cui la leadership e lo sviluppo dei leader

- Competenze HR approfondite e una forte comprensione delle diverse esigenze aziendali, dei mercati del lavoro e dei contesti organizzativi

- Dimostrare l'esperienza nell'attuazione delle trasformazioni e nell'ulteriore sviluppo dei processi e degli strumenti HR, nonché forti competenze concettuali e orientate all'implementazione

descriptionByLocale.en:
As Head of Human Resources, you play a decisive role in shaping the future of PostFinance from an HR perspective. Human Resources is part of the Corporate Development & People division, in whose management team you participate and report directly to the responsible member of the management. Together with your HR management team, you will be responsible for the HR strategy and create the human, cultural and organizational prerequisites for PostFinance to achieve its strategic and financial goals. You will continue to develop Human Resources as a modern, efficient and future-oriented function and support the management and the entire organization effectively through change and transformation processes.

You can do that.

- You will lead the Human Resources department independently and develop the HR organization strategically, impact-oriented and future-oriented by recognizing the need for action at an early stage and setting your own impulses.

- You are responsible for HR Business Partnering, People Attraction, HR Advisory, Organizational Development and HR Business Excellence and ensure their effective interaction.

- You are responsible for human resources strategy and ensure that HR makes a significant contribution to achieving strategic and financial corporate goals

- You will continue to shape key HR topics along the entire employee lifecycle, from recruitment and development of employees to talent and succession management to performance management and compensation.

- You consistently tailor HR services to the needs of the organization and ensure efficient processes, modern systems and high service quality

- You advise as a sparring partner: in the CEO and the management on strategic HR issues and achieve together with the HR Business Partners:in effect in organizational development, succession planning and change management

- You will conduct the cooperation and negotiations with the social partners as well as with the Group, especially on GAV and wage issues

You bring that with you

- University degree or higher education in business administration, ideally supplemented by further education in general management or human resources

- Several years of proven experience in human resources management as well as in a demanding leadership function, including leadership and development of leaders

- In-depth HR competence and a strong understanding of different business needs, labour markets and organizational contexts

- Demonstrate experience in the implementation of transformations and in the further development of HR processes and instruments as well as strong conceptual and implementation-oriented skills

- Strategic, entrepreneurial and analytical thinking and the ability to translate complex relationships into concrete effects

- Strong communication and stakeholder management expertise as well as enjoyment of cross-divisional cooperation at different management levels

- Very good German and English skills, further language skills as a plus

titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire d'examen en gouvernance d'entreprise (h/f/d)

descriptionByLocale.it:
Garantiamo che PostFinance sia regolamentato
• I requisiti sono soddisfatti in ogni momento in modo professionale, trasparente ed efficace. In questo ruolo chiave, sarai responsabile della pianificazione, del coordinamento e del sostegno dei controlli in loco della FINMA e delle verifiche di controllo da parte della società di revisione esterna. Con la vostra visione d'insieme, la vostra anzianità e il vostro giudizio Assicurate il supporto di audit professionale e fornite orientamento in un ambiente normativo esigente e date un contributo significativo alla forte governance e allo sviluppo sostenibile di PostFinance.
descriptionByLocale.en:
We ensure that PostFinance complies with regulatory requirements
• Respond to requirements professionally, transparently and effectively at all times. In this key role, you will be responsible for planning, coordinating and supporting on-site inspections by FINMA and the regulatory audit by the external audit firm. With your overview, seniority and judgement, you will ensure professional audit support and provide orientation in a demanding regulatory environment and make a significant contribution to strong governance and the sustainable development of PostFinance.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Wir stellen sicher, dass PostFinance regulatorischen Anforderungen jederzeit professionell, transparent und wirkungsvoll begegnet. In dieser Schlüsselrolle verantwortest Du die Planung, Koordination und Begleitung von Vor-Ort-Kontrollen der FINMA sowie der aufsichtsrechtlichen Prüfung durch die externe Prüfgesellschaft. Mit deinem Überblick, Deiner Seniorität und deinem Urteilsvermögen stellst Du eine professionelle Prüfungsbegleitung sicher und schaffst Orientierung in einem anspruchsvollen regulatorischen Umfeld und leistest einen wesentlichen Beitrag zu einer starken Governance sowie zur nachhaltigen Weiterentwicklung von PostFinance.

Das kannst du bewirken

- Du steuerst FINMA-Reviews sowie aufsichtsrechtliche Prüfungen wirksam und bist Ansprechperson für Fragen zu Prüfungsprozessen und -anforderungen innerhalb von PostFinance

- Du bereitest Faktenchecks, Stellungnahmen und weitere prüfungsrelevante Entscheidungsgrundlagen konsistent auf, koordinierst die Einbindung relevanter Stakeholder und stellst eine adressatengerechte Berichterstattung an Geschäftsleitung, Verwaltungsrat und Ausschüsse sicher

- Du schaffst Transparenz über Revisionsfeststellungen, Massnahmen und Pendenzen, überwachst deren Nachverfolgung und stellst die termingerechte Umsetzung sicher

- Du vertrittst Prüfungs- und Revisionsthemen in Sitzungen von Geschäftsleitung, Verwaltungsrat und Ausschüssen und erläuterst komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich und adressatengerecht

- Du unterstützt die Weiterentwicklung des Prüfungs- und Aufsichtsmanagements sowie der dazugehörigen Prozesse und stärkst damit Governance, Effizienz und Wirksamkeit innerhalb von PostFinance

Das bringst du mit

- Hochschulabschluss (FH/Uni) in Betriebswirtschaft, Finance, Wirtschaftsrecht oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung sowie Weiterbildung als dipl. Wirtschaftsprüfer:in, CIA oder gleichwertig

- Mehrjährige Erfahrung im regulatorischen Revisionsumfeld, idealerweise bei einer Big4-Prüfgesellschaft, einer Bank oder einer Aufsichtsbehörde, mit Praxis in der Steuerung und Begleitung von FINMA-Reviews und aufsichtsrechtlichen Prüfungen

- Fundiertes Verständnis regulatorischer Anforderungen, wirksamer Governance-Strukturen sowie von Kontroll- und Steuerungssystemen im Bankumfeld

- Souveränes Auftreten und ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke im Umgang mit Geschäftsleitungen, Verwaltungsräten, Aufsichtsbehörden und externen Prüfgesellschaften sowie Fähigkeit zur adressatengerechten Zusammenführung unterschiedlicher Perspektiven

- Ausgeprägte analytische und konzeptionelle Stärke mit Fähigkeit zur verständlichen Aufbereitung komplexer aufsichtsrechtlicher und revisionsrelevanter Sachverhalte, zur Schaffung von Orientierung und zur Bereitstellung fundierter Entscheidungsgrundlagen für verschiedene Gremien

- Stilsicheres Deutsch und sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift; weitere Landessprachen als Plus
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Nous veillons à ce que PostFinance respecte les exigences réglementaires
• Répondre aux exigences de manière professionnelle, transparente et efficace en permanence. Dans ce rôle clé, vous serez responsable de la planification, de la coordination et du soutien des inspections sur site par la FINMA ainsi que de l'audit réglementaire par le cabinet d'audit externe. Grâce à votre vue d'ensemble, votre ancienneté et votre jugement, vous garantirez un accompagnement professionnel en audit, vous apporterez une orientation dans un environnement réglementaire exigeant et apporterez une contribution significative à une gouvernance solide et au développement durable de PostFinance.

titleByLocale.fr: Senior Fullstack Ingénieur (w/m/d)

descriptionByLocale.it:
Nel Solution Team Delivery Tools & Automation, si sviluppa e gestisce la piattaforma centrale di dati di prova PostFinance, che consente lo sviluppo e il test su tutti i livelli. Assicurati che sviluppatori e tester possano accedere rapidamente ai dati di test sintetici di alta qualità. In un ambiente agile, progetta soluzioni scalabili che combinano stabilità e innovazione. In questo modo, si accelera e ottimizzare il ciclo di vita di consegna del software e dare un contributo importante all'intera organizzazione di sviluppo di PostFinance.

Sviluppi e gestisci la nostra piattaforma dati di test come ingegnere fullstack, dal portale self-service angolare a Java e servizi di avvio primavera al funzionamento su Kubernetes

Costruire la piattaforma insieme al team, realizzare nuove funzioni e scalarli per crescere
• Requisiti

Si utilizza la vostra esperienza specificamente per garantire la stabilità, le prestazioni e la resilienza di un paesaggio di sistema ampiamente usato e distribuito

Sei responsabile dell'intero ciclo di vita dal concepimento al funzionamento al supporto end-to-end

Formate attivamente le decisioni tecniche nel team e sviluppate la nostra architettura e le nostre tecnologie insieme al proprietario dell'architettura

Si passa alla vostra conoscenza, promuovere colleghi meno esperti e spingere i nostri metodi di lavoro e standard di qualità con il team

Lo porti con te.

Istruzione superiore in informatica (FH/Uni) o qualificazione comparabile

Diversi anni di esperienza nello sviluppo full-stack con Java e Spring Boot e conoscenze nello sviluppo front-end con Angular e Typescript

Gestione sicura di Docker, Kubernetes e GitLab CI nonché esperienza con GitOps, Infrastrutture come Codice e Osservabilità

Familiarità con sistemi distribuiti e tecnologie di integrazione come Kafka, REST, SOAP e JMS e database relazionali

Standard di alta qualità, un pronunciato atteggiamento DevOps e il godimento dello sviluppo sostenibile di una piattaforma che è cresciuta nel corso degli anni

Esperienza nell'ambiente bancario o finanziario, nonché una buona comprensione della sperimentazione e dell'automazione dei test

Metodo di lavoro orientato al team e responsabile con l'obiettivo di creare soluzioni, qualità e cooperazione nel team

Molto buona conoscenza del tedesco e buona conoscenza dell'inglese in parola e scrittura
descriptionByLocale.en:
In the Solution Team Delivery Tools & Automation, you develop and operate PostFinance’s central test data platform, which enables development and testing across all levels. You make sure that developers and testers can quickly access high-quality synthetic test data. In an agile environment, you design scalable solutions that combine stability and innovation. In this way, you accelerate and optimize the software delivery lifecycle and make an important contribution to the entire development organization of PostFinance.

You can do that.

You develop and operate our test data platform as a fullstack engineer, from the Angular self-service portal to Java and spring boot services to operation on Kubernetes

You build the platform together with the team, realize new functions and scale them for growing
• Requirements

You use your experience specifically to ensure stability, performance and resilience of a widely used, distributed system landscape

You are responsible for the entire lifecycle from conception to operation to end-to-end support

You actively shape technical decisions in the team and develop our architecture and technologies together with the Architecture Owner

You pass on your knowledge, promote less experienced colleagues and push our working methods and quality standards with the team

You bring that with you

Higher education in computer science (FH/Uni) or comparable qualification

Several years of experience in full-stack development with Java and Spring Boot as well as knowledge in front-end development with Angular and Typescript

Secure handling of Docker, Kubernetes and GitLab CI as well as experience with GitOps, Infrastructure as Code and Observability

Familiarity with distributed systems and integration technologies such as Kafka, REST, SOAP and JMS as well as relational databases

High quality standards, pronounced DevOps attitude and enjoyment of the sustainable development of a platform that has grown over the years

Experience in the banking or financial environment as well as a good understanding of testing and test automation

Team-oriented and self-responsible working method with the aim of co-creating solutions, quality and cooperation in the team

Very good knowledge of German and good knowledge of English in word and writing
descriptionByLocale.de:

- Du gibst dein Wissen weiter, förderst weniger erfahrene Kolleg:innen und treibst mit dem Team unsere Arbeitsweisen und Qualitätsstandards voran

- Sicherer Umgang mit Docker, Kubernetes und GitLab CI sowie Erfahrung mit GitOps, Infrastructure as Code und Observability von Vorteil

- Vertrautheit mit verteilten Systemen und Integrationstechnologien wie Kafka, REST, SOAP und JMS sowie mit relationalen Datenbanken

- Hoher Qualitätsanspruch, ausgeprägte DevOps-Haltung und Freude an der nachhaltigen Weiterentwicklung einer über Jahre gewachsenen Plattform

- Erfahrung im Banken- oder Finanzumfeld sowie gutes Verständnis für Testing und Testautomatisierung von Vorteil

- Teamorientierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise mit dem Anspruch zur Mitgestaltung von Lösungen, Qualität und Zusammenarbeit im Team

- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
descriptionByLocale.fr:

Bei PostFinance gestaltest du die Zukunft des Third Party Managements aktiv mit. Du pflegst und entwickelst das TPM-Framework weiter, inklusive Weisungen, Handbüchern, Methoden, Operationalisierung regulatorischer Vorgaben (z.B. FINMA) und Prozessbeschreibungen

Du bist zentrale Anlaufstelle für TPM-Stakeholder aus der 2nd Line und arbeitest eng mit Business, Third Party Management, Risk, Compliance und weiteren Fachstellen zusammen

Du unterstützt die kontinuierliche Verbesserung der TPM-Prozesse und vereinst regulatorische, fachliche sowie operative
• Anforderungen

Tertiärer Abschluss (HF, FH oder Uni) in Betriebswirtschaft, Wirtschaftsrecht, Compliance, Risk Management, Banking oder eine vergleichbare berufliche Aus- oder Weiterbildung

Gutes Verständnis regulatorischer

Ausgeprägte analytische und konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten sowie Freude an strukturierter, adressatengerechter und umsetzungsorientierter Aufbereitung komplexer Sachverhalte

Starkes Flair für bereichsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit, sicheres Auftreten und Fähigkeit zur pragmatischen Verbindung unterschiedlicher

descriptionByLocale.en:
At PostFinance, you actively shape the future of third-party management. In the Competence Center Procurement & Third Party Management you develop frameworks, methods and processes and ensure their effective implementation. You work closely with business, risk, compliance and other specialist departments and ensure transparency and compliance throughout the entire lifecycle. This will help secure strong partnerships and strengthen PostFinance’s innovative power.

You can do that.

You maintain and develop the TPM framework further, including instructions, manuals, methods, operationalization of regulatory requirements (e.g. FINMA) and process descriptions

You control and develop the end-to-end lifecycle for third-party relationships – from needs clarification to onboarding, contract and risk management to monitoring, re-assessment and exit.

You take on the technical responsibility for TPM-relevant tools, data models, the central partnership register and evaluations and ensure their further development

You create management and control reports and create transparency about partnerships, investments, sub-accordants as well as relevant risks and measures

You are the central point of contact for TPM stakeholders from the 2nd Line and work closely with Business, Third Party Management, Risk, Compliance and other specialists

You support the continuous improvement of TPM processes and unite regulatory, professional and operational

Tertiary degree (HF, FH or university) in business administration, business law, compliance, risk management, banking or a comparable vocational education or training

Several years of professional experience in third party management, governance, risk, compliance or process management, ideally in the financial environment

Experience in the conception and further development of frameworks, methods, instructions, processes or control mechanisms

Good understanding of regulatory
• Requirements related to third parties, outsourcing, governance and internal control processes

Strong analytical and conceptual skills as well as enjoyment of structured, user-friendly and implementation-oriented preparation of complex issues

Strong flair for cross-sectoral cooperation, secure appearance and ability to pragmatically connect different

Dans le centre de compétences Approvisionnement et gestion de tiers, vous développez des cadres, des méthodes et des processus et assurez leur mise en œuvre efficace. Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les entreprises, les risques, la conformité et d'autres services spécialisés et assurez la transparence et la conformité tout au long du cycle de vie. Cela permettra d'établir de solides partenariats et de renforcer la puissance innovante de PostFinance.

descriptionByLocale.en:

descriptionByLocale.it:
In qualità di Senior Specialist TPRM Security Monitoring con un focus su IT Security, Cyber e ICT, si garantisce il monitoraggio efficace dei rischi di sicurezza tecnica e resilienza dei nostri terzi. Con la vostra comprensione tecnica e affinità con BCM, rafforzate la sicurezza, la disponibilità e la resilienza dei servizi forniti da PostFinance.

Puoi farlo.

- Pianifica, coordina e documenta controlli di sicurezza basati sui rischi e rivalutazioni periodiche a terzi.

- Valuterai le prove di sicurezza informatica, cyber, ICT, gestione delle vulnerabilità, misure di protezione tecnica, BCM e resilienza operativa.

- Tra le altre cose, analizzerai test di penetrazione, vulnerabilità, certificazione, ISAE, SOC e altri rapporti di assicurazione tecnica.

- Valuta le deviazioni tecniche e i risultati, definisci le misure adeguate insieme agli organismi specializzati e garantisci il loro monitoraggio.

- Monitorare la conformità ai requisiti di sicurezza contrattuali e aumentare i rischi tecnici o operativi.

- Si crea un controllo significativo, la segnalazione del rischio e della gestione e supporta le richieste di audit, audit e supervisione.

- Sviluppi il catalogo di controllo, i requisiti di prova, la logica di valutazione e il supporto degli strumenti insieme ai settori specializzati in materia di sicurezza.

Lo porti con te.

- Laurea superiore in sicurezza informatica, informatica, informatica aziendale o una qualifica paragonabile.

- Diversi anni di esperienza nella sicurezza informatica, rischio informatico, gestione del rischio ICT, sicurezza, BCM o gestione del rischio di terze parti.

- Hai esperienza nell'ambiente bancario e conosci i requisiti normativi essenziali per la sicurezza delle informazioni, i rischi operativi e la gestione dei rischi di terzi.

- Hai esperienza nella pianificazione, nel coordinamento e nella conduzione di controlli di sicurezza e di rischio con terze parti e puoi valutare e monitorare i risultati e le misure risultanti in modo strutturato.

- Conoscenza approfondita dei controlli di sicurezza tecnica e dei framework stabiliti come ISO 27001 o NIST.

- Esperienza nella valutazione di prove tecniche, vulnerabilità, rapporti di audit, ricerca e misure di bonifica.

- Buona comprensione della resilienza delle TIC, della continuità aziendale e dei requisiti normativi nell'ambiente finanziario.

- Metodi di lavoro analitici e orientati alla soluzione, nonché la capacità di comunicare i problemi tecnici in tedesco in modo indirizzabile e vincolante.
descriptionByLocale.en:
As a Senior Specialist TPRM Security Monitoring with a focus on IT Security, Cyber and ICT, you ensure the effective monitoring of technical security and resilience risks of our third parties. With your technical understanding and affinity to BCM, you strengthen the security, availability and resilience of the services provided by PostFinance.

You can do that.

- You plan, coordinate and document risk-based security controls and periodic re-assessments at third parties.

- You will assess evidence of IT security, cyber, ICT, vulnerability management, technical protection measures, BCM and operational resilience.

- Among other things, you will analyze penetration test, vulnerability, certification, ISAE, SOC and other technical assurance reports.

- You evaluate technical deviations and findings, define suitable measures together with the specialist bodies and ensure their tracking.

- You monitor compliance with contractual security requirements and escalate material technical or operational risks.

- You create meaningful control, risk and management reporting and support audit, audit and supervisory requests.

- You develop control catalogue, evidence requirements, evaluation logic and tool support together with the relevant security specialist areas.

You bring that with you

- Higher degree in Cyber Security, Computer Science, Business Informatics or a comparable qualification.

- Several years of experience in IT security, cyber risk, ICT risk management, security assurance, BCM or third party risk management.

- You have experience in the banking environment and know the essential regulatory requirements for information security, operational risks and third party risk management.

- You have experience in planning, coordinating and conducting security and risk audits with third parties and can assess and track findings and resulting measures in a structured manner.

- In-depth knowledge of technical security controls and established frameworks such as ISO 27001 or NIST.

- Experience in assessing technical evidence, vulnerabilities, audit reports, finding and remediation measures.

- Good understanding of ICT resilience, business continuity and regulatory requirements in the financial environment.

- Analytical and solution-oriented working methods as well as the ability to communicate technical issues in German in an addressable and binding manner.
descriptionByLocale.de:

- Du planst, koordinierst und dokumentierst risikobasierte Security-Kontrollen und periodische Re-Assessments bei Drittparteien.

- Du erstellst aussagekräftige Kontroll-, Risiko- und Management-Reportings und unterstützt Revisions-, Audit- und Aufsichtsanfragen.

- Mehrjährige Erfahrung in IT-Security, Cyber Risk, IKT-Risikomanagement, Security Assurance, BCM oder Third Party Risk Management.

- Gutes Verständnis von IKT-Resilienz, Business Continuity und regulatorischen Anforderungen im Finanzumfeld.

- Analytische und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie die Fähigkeit, technische Sachverhalte adressatengerecht und verbindlich auf Deutsch zu kommunizieren.

titleByLocale.fr: Responsable du centre de cyberdéfense

descriptionByLocale.it:

In un ambiente di minaccia in continua evoluzione, tu e il tuo team assicurate che le minacce informatiche vengano rilevate in anticipo, trattate professionalmente ed efficacemente riparate. Con la tua previsione strategica, l'esperienza di leadership e la comprensione tecnica, svilupperai continuamente il nostro Cyber Defense Center e formerai attivamente il panorama della sicurezza informatica di PostFinance. Per questo compito responsabile, stiamo cercando una personalità impegnata che ripensa la sicurezza e plasma il futuro del nostro Cyber Defense Center.

Puoi farlo.

- Insieme al vostro team, assicurate il funzionamento del Cyber Defense Center – dal monitoraggio della sicurezza e dal triage degli eventi alla gestione degli incidenti e al controllo dell'operazione Pikett.

- Coordinate la risposta degli incidenti in caso di incidenti critici per la sicurezza e lavorate a stretto contatto con gli specialisti IT e i responsabili della gestione delle emergenze.

- Insieme al tuo team, svilupperai continuamente le capacità di rilevamento del Cyber Defense Center e identificherai le minacce nascoste all'inizio attraverso la caccia mirata alle minacce.

- Sei responsabile dell'intelligenza delle minacce informatiche e assicurati che le informazioni sulle minacce attuali siano efficacemente integrate nei processi di rilevamento e risposta

- Sei responsabile per le piattaforme di cyber-difesa e il loro sviluppo continuo e garantire la loro futura fattibilità in stretta collaborazione con l'ingegneria e il funzionamento.

- È possibile gestire con report significativi e regolari, trasparenza sullo stato di sicurezza e l'efficacia del Cyber Defense Center

Lo porti con te.

- Laurea in informatica, idealmente con un approfondimento nella sicurezza informatica, o istruzione comparabile

- Diversi anni di esperienza di leadership e la capacità di sviluppare e guidare con successo i team in situazioni difficili

- Diversi anni di esperienza pratica in un Security Operations Center o Cyber Defense Center e una comprensione approfondita delle moderne architetture di sicurezza informatica

- Conoscenza dell'intelligenza della minaccia informatica, della caccia alle minacce o dell'ingegneria di rilevamento come un plus

- Capacità calma, decisionale e sovranità in situazioni critiche

- Forte capacità di comunicazione a diversi livelli gerarchici
descriptionByLocale.en:
PostFinance’s Cyber Defense Center is part of centralized security and monitors the entire cyber landscape. In an ever-changing threat environment, you and your team ensure that cyber threats are detected early, treated professionally and effectively fended off. With your strategic foresight, leadership experience and technical understanding, you will continuously develop our Cyber Defense Center and actively shape the cyber security landscape of PostFinance. For this responsible task, we are looking for a committed personality who will rethink security and shape the future of our Cyber Defense Center.

You can do that.

- You take overall responsibility for the Cyber Defense Center and continuously develop its vision, strategy and performance

- Together with your team, you ensure the operation of the Cyber Defense Center – from security monitoring and event triage to incident handling and the control of the Pikett operation.

- You coordinate incident response in the event of security-critical incidents and work closely with IT specialists and those responsible for emergency management.

- Together with your team, you will continuously develop the detection capabilities of the Cyber Defense Center and identify hidden threats early on through targeted threat hunting.

- You are responsible for cyber threat intelligence and ensure that current threat information is effectively integrated into the detection and response processes

- You are responsible for the cyber defense platforms and their continuous development and ensure their future viability in close cooperation with engineering and operation.

- You can manage with meaningful and regular reporting, transparency about the security status and the effectiveness of the Cyber Defense Center

You bring that with you

- Graduate degree in computer science, ideally with a deepening in cyber security, or comparable education

- Several years of leadership experience and the ability to successfully develop and lead teams in challenging situations

- Several years of practical experience in a Security Operations Center or Cyber Defense Center as well as an in-depth understanding of modern cyber security architectures

- Knowledge of cyber threat intelligence, threat hunting or detection engineering as a plus

- Calm, decision-making ability and sovereignty in critical situations

- Strong communication skills at different hierarchical levels

titleByLocale.fr: Service à la clientèle Centre client

descriptionByLocale.it:
Al Customer Center di PostFinance, il nostro focus è quello di fornire un servizio di prima classe ai nostri clienti. Il nostro obiettivo è comprendere le loro preoccupazioni finanziarie e ispirarle attraverso consigli amichevoli e competenti. Ci sforziamo di creare un'esperienza positiva in ogni interazione e di rafforzare la connessione dei nostri clienti con PostFinance. Come futuro membro del Customer Center, diventerai parte di questa missione e avrai l'opportunità di lavorare in un ambiente dinamico e contribuire direttamente al successo di PostFinance. Sembra eccitante? Allora non vediamo l'ora della vostra applicazione – recentemente anche abbastanza semplicemente via WhatsApp.

Puoi farlo.

- Come prima persona di contatto per i nostri clienti: all'interno si prende il sopravvento professionale del loro telefono e richieste scritte sui nostri prodotti e servizi

- Identificare e sfruttare attivamente le opportunità di vendita offrendo ai nostri clienti prodotti e servizi su misura per le loro esigenze

- Con la vostra natura empatica, comunicativa e aperta, ispirate i nostri diversi clienti e create un'esperienza clienti positiva.

Lo porti con te.

- Completata l'istruzione di base o l'esperienza nel settore dei servizi

- Godetevi il contatto telefonico con i clienti, idealmente già con esperienza nel servizio clienti e vendite

- Eccellente capacità di comunicazione orale in tedesco e in una seconda lingua nazionale (francese o italiano)

- Esperienza nell'uso parallelo di diverse applicazioni IT e strumenti di comunicazione (telefono, e-mail, chat)

- Capacità di far fronte ai cambiamenti in un ambiente in rapida evoluzione e di rispondere in modo sensibile alle diverse esigenze dei nostri clienti:

- Durante la fase introduttiva, che si completa sul sito al sito (di solito da 3 a 6 mesi, a seconda delle conoscenze e delle esperienze precedenti), si lavora almeno al 50%. Dopo di che, è possibile regolare il livello di lavoro se desiderato e lavorare in ufficio dopo la consultazione con il vostro manager. Le ore di lavoro variano dal lunedì al venerdì dalle 08:00 alle 20:15 e dal sabato dalle 08:00 alle 17:15
descriptionByLocale.en:

Our goal is to understand their financial concerns and to inspire them through friendly and competent advice. We strive to create a positive experience in every interaction and to strengthen the connection of our customers with PostFinance. As a future member of the Customer Center, you will become part of this mission and have the opportunity to work in a dynamic environment and contribute directly to the success of PostFinance. Sounds exciting? Then we look forward to your application – newly also quite simply via WhatsApp.

You can do that.

- As the first contact person for our customers: inside you take over the professional processing of their telephone and written inquiries about our products and services

- You proactively identify and exploit sales opportunities by offering our customers products and services tailored to their needs

- With your empathetic, communicative and open nature, you inspire our diverse customers and create a positive customer experience.

You bring that with you

- Completed basic education or experience in the service sector

- Enjoy telephone customer contact, ideally already with experience in customer service and sales

- Excellent oral communication skills in German as well as in a second national language (French or Italian)

- Experienced in the parallel use of several IT applications and communication tools (telephone, email, chat)

- Ability to cope with changing shifts in a fast-moving environment and to respond sensitively to the diverse needs of our customers:

- During the introductory phase, which you complete on site at the site (usually 3 to 6 months, depending on your previous knowledge and experience), you work at least 50%. After that, you can adjust your employment level if desired and work in the home office after consultation with your manager. Your working hours vary from Monday to Friday between 08:00 and 20:15 and Saturdays between 08:00 and 17:15
descriptionByLocale.de:

- Versiert im parallelen Einsatz mehrerer IT-Anwendungen und Kommunikationstools (Telefon, E-Mail, Chat)

- Fähigkeit, sich in einem schnelllebigen Umfeld mit wechselnden Schichten zurechtzufinden und einfühlsam auf die vielfältigen Bedürfnisse unserer Kund:innen einzugehen

- Während der Einführungsphase, die du vor Ort am Standort absolvierst (in der Regel 3 bis 6 Monate, abhängig von deinen Vorkenntnissen und Erfahrungen), arbeitest du mindestens 50%. titleByLocale.fr: Chef d'équipe Test Data Platform (w/m/d)

descriptionByLocale.it:

- Insieme a Product Owner e all'Architetture Owner, si plasma la leadership del team e fornisce chiarezza in responsabilità, priorità e collaborazione

- Si creano le condizioni quadro in modo che il team possa concentrarsi su soluzioni di creazione di valore, di alta qualità e affidabili

- Svilupperai continuamente la collaborazione e i metodi di lavoro del team, eliminando gli ostacoli che rendono difficile la consegna efficiente del software.

- Promuovi l'apprendimento, il feedback, l'auto-organizzazione e una cultura ingegneristica in cui si vive un continuo miglioramento.

- Ti aiuterà a plasmare l'ulteriore sviluppo del Solution Team Delivery Tool & Automation e portare la prospettiva del tuo team alle decisioni generali

- Si collega attraverso i confini del team e promuovere lo scambio di conoscenze e migliori pratiche all'interno di PostFinance

Lo porti con te.

- Una laurea avanzata in informatica informatica o informatica aziendale o una qualifica paragonabile attraverso diversi anni di esperienza professionale

- Diversi anni di esperienza nei team leader e sviluppo di software o ingegneria

- Una buona comprensione dello sviluppo software moderno, DevOps e processi di consegna automatizzati

- Esperienza pratica con metodi di lavoro agili e magre come Scrum o Kanban. Non capisci l'agilità come fine in sé, ma come mezzo per fornire risultati efficaci.

- Esperienza nei processi di sviluppo e cambiamento del team e la capacità di dare costantemente la responsabilità al team

- Forte capacità di comunicazione, moderazione e risoluzione dei conflitti, nonché empatia e forza decisionale

descriptionByLocale.en:
In Solution Team Delivery Tools & Automation, you and your team will continue to develop PostFinance’s central test data platform (TDP). It enables developers and testers to provide synthetic test data easily, quickly and reliably for their development and testing processes.

As a team lead, you lead and develop an interdisciplinary engineering team and create the conditions for people, technology and collaboration to develop their potential. Together with Product Owner and Architecture Owner, you ensure clear framework conditions, effective cooperation and sustainable development of the team.

This will make an important contribution to faster, more reliable and more automated software development at PostFinance.

You can do that.

- You lead and develop your team in terms of personnel, methodology and organization and create an environment in which personal responsibility and cooperation are a matter of course.

- Together with Product Owner and Architecture Owner, you shape the leadership of the team and provide clarity in responsibility, priorities and collaboration

- You create the framework conditions so that the team can focus on value-creating, high-quality and reliable solutions

- You will continuously develop the team’s collaboration and working methods, eliminating obstacles that make efficient software delivery difficult.

- You promote learning, feedback, self-organization and an engineering culture where continuous improvement is lived.

- You will help shape the further development of the Solution Team Delivery Tool & Automation and bring your team’s perspective to overall decisions

- You network across team boundaries and promote the exchange of knowledge and best practices within PostFinance

You bring that with you

- An advanced degree in computer science or business informatics or a comparable qualification through several years of professional experience

- Several years of experience in leading and developing software or engineering teams

- A good understanding of modern software development, DevOps and automated delivery processes

- Practical experience with agile and lean working methods such as Scrum or Kanban. You do not understand agility as an end in itself, but as a means to deliver effective results.

- Experience in team development and change processes as well as the ability to consistently give responsibility to the team

- Strong communication, moderation and conflict resolution skills as well as empathy and decision-making strength

- Negotiating knowledge of German and English
descriptionByLocale.de:

Das bringst du mit

- Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Führung und Entwicklung von Software- oder Engineering-Teams

descriptionByLocale.it:
Identificare i rischi in una fase iniziale, comprendere le connessioni e plasmare attivamente il futuro: In questo ruolo chiave, monitori i rischi di terze parti e aiuti PostFinance ad essere sicuro e di successo anche in un ambiente esigente e dinamico. Si otterrà una visione unica nei processi aziendali chiave della banca e argomenti e lavorare insieme con specialisti e dirigenti da una vasta gamma di settori. Particolarmente emozionante: Il tema della gestione del rischio di terzi è attualmente in fase di espansione. Questo ti dà l'opportunità di modellare nuovi processi e standard e di plasmare attivamente l'ulteriore sviluppo di questa funzione. Se si desidera analizzare i rischi complessi, assumersi la responsabilità e lavorare in un ambiente con molta indipendenza e portata creativa, non vediamo l'ora di conoscerla.

Puoi farlo.

- Nell'ambito del controllo del rischio indipendente (2a linea), si controllano i rischi e i controlli nell'area di terzi e valutano la loro gestione appropriata.

- Assicurare l'identificazione e la valutazione dei rischi operativi e l'efficacia dei controlli rilevanti nell'ambito del sistema di controllo interno

- Analizzerai situazioni di rischio complesse, deriva raccomandazioni ben fondate e presenterai i tuoi risultati a dipartimenti specializzati, gestione e comitati in modo appropriato.

- Svilupperai attivamente il monitoraggio di terzi e stabilirai nuovi processi, metodi e standard per la gestione del rischio di terzi orientata al futuro

- Effettuerai attività di monitoraggio basate sui rischi, come il monitoraggio dei rischi finanziari, media o di concentrazione, le convalida delle due diligence e la valutazione dei rapporti ISAE/SOC

- Preparate le basi per il processo decisionale per la gestione e il consiglio di amministrazione e sostenete l'ulteriore sviluppo del nostro strumento di gestione dei rischi e le valutazioni basate sui dati

Lo porti con te.

- Almeno cinque anni di esperienza professionale nella gestione del rischio di terzi, gestione del rischio di outsourcing, gestione del rischio operativo o sistema di controllo interno (ICS)

- Completamento di una scuola tecnica superiore, college di scienze applicate o università, preferibilmente in amministrazione aziendale, gestione del rischio, legge o una disciplina comparabile

- Forte capacità analitiche e concettuali e la capacità di fare valutazioni sonore di questioni complesse

- Elevato livello di iniziativa, di lavoro autonomo e di piacere nel promuovere temi di propria responsabilità e priorità

- Convincere l'aspetto e l'assertività in scambio con dipartimenti, dirigenti e comitati

- Forte comunicazione e competenza del team nonché entusiasmo per contribuire a plasmare nuovi processi, metodi e standard
descriptionByLocale.en:
Identify risks at an early stage, understand connections and actively shape the future: In this key role, you monitor third-party risks and help PostFinance to be safe and successful even in a demanding and dynamic environment. You will gain a unique insight into the bank’s key business processes and topics and work together with specialists and executives from a wide range of areas. Particularly exciting: The topic of third party risk management is currently being further expanded. This gives you the opportunity to shape new processes and standards and to actively shape the further development of this function. If you want to analyse complex risks, take on responsibility and work in an environment with a lot of independence and creative scope, we look forward to getting to know you.

You can do that.

- As part of the independent risk control (2nd Line), you monitor the risks and controls in the area of third parties and assess their appropriate management.

- Ensure the identification and evaluation of operational risks and the effectiveness of relevant controls under the internal control system

- You will analyze complex risk situations, derive well-founded recommendations and present your findings to specialist departments, management and committees appropriately.

- You will actively develop the monitoring of third parties and establish new processes, methods and standards for future-oriented third party risk management

- You will perform risk-based monitoring activities such as financial, media or concentration risk monitoring, due diligence validations and the assessment of ISAE/SOC reports

- You prepare the basis for decision-making for the management and board of directors and support the further development of our risk management tool as well as data-based evaluations

You bring that with you

- At least five years of professional experience in third party risk management, outsourcing risk management, operational risk management or internal control system (ICS)

- Completion of a higher technical school, college of applied sciences or university, preferably in business administration, risk management, law or a comparable discipline

- Strong analytical and conceptual skills as well as the ability to make sound assessments of complex issues

- High level of initiative, self-employment and pleasure in promoting topics on your own responsibility and setting priorities

- Convincing appearance and assertiveness in exchange with departments, managers and committees

- Strong communication and team competence as well as enthusiasm to help shape new processes, methods and standards
descriptionByLocale.de:
Risiken frühzeitig erkennen, Zusammenhänge verstehen und die Zukunft aktiv mitgestalten: In dieser Schlüsselrolle überwachst du Drittparteirisiken und trägst dazu bei, dass PostFinance auch in einem anspruchsvollen und dynamischen Umfeld sicher und erfolgreich unterwegs ist. Dabei erhältst du einen einzigartigen Einblick in die wesentlichen Geschäftsprozesse und Themenfelder der Bank und arbeitest mit Fach- und Führungskräften unterschiedlichster Bereiche zusammen. Besonders spannend: Das Thema Third Party Risk Management wird aktuell weiter ausgebaut. Dadurch bekommst du die Möglichkeit, neue Prozesse und Standards mitzugestalten und die Weiterentwicklung dieser Funktion aktiv mitzuprägen. Wenn du komplexe Risiken analysieren, Verantwortung übernehmen und in einem Umfeld mit viel Selbstständigkeit und Gestaltungsspielraum wirken möchtest, freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Das kannst du bewirken

- Du überwachst als Teil der unabhängigen Risikokontrolle (2nd Line) die Risiken und Kontrollen im Bereich Drittparteien und beurteilst deren angemessene Steuerung

- Du stellst die Identifikation und Bewertung operationeller Risiken sowie die Wirksamkeit relevanter Kontrollen im Rahmen des Internen Kontrollsystems sicher

- Du analysierst komplexe Risikosituationen, leitest fundierte Empfehlungen ab und präsentierst deine Erkenntnisse adressatengerecht gegenüber Fachbereichen, Management und Gremien

- Du entwickelst die Überwachung von Drittparteien aktiv weiter und etablierst neue Prozesse, Methoden und Standards für ein zukunftsgerichtetes Third Party Risk Management

- Du führst risikobasierte Überwachungstätigkeiten wie Finanz-, Medien- oder Konzentrationsrisiko-Monitorings, Due-Diligence-Validierungen sowie die Beurteilung von ISAE-/SOC-Berichten durch

- Du bereitest Entscheidungsgrundlagen für Geschäftsleitung und Verwaltungsrat auf und unterstützt die Weiterentwicklung unseres Risikomanagementtools sowie datenbasierter Auswertungen

Das bringst du mit

- Mindestens fünf Jahre Berufserfahrung im Third Party Risk Management, Outsourcing Risk Management, operationellen Risikomanagement oder Internen Kontrollsystem (IKS)

- Abschluss einer höheren Fachschule, Fachhochschule oder Universität, vorzugsweise in Betriebswirtschaft, Risk Management, Rechtswissenschaften oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung

- Ausgeprägte analytische und konzeptionelle Skills sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe Sachverhalte fundiert zu beurteilen

- Hohe Eigeninitiative, Selbstständigkeit und Freude daran, Themen eigenverantwortlich voranzutreiben und Prioritäten zu setzen

- Überzeugendes Auftreten sowie Durchsetzungsvermögen im Austausch mit Fachbereichen, Führungskräften und Gremien

- Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Teamkompetenz sowie Begeisterung, neue Prozesse, Methoden und Standards mitzugestalten
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Identifier les risques à un stade précoce, comprendre les liens et façonner activement l'avenir : Dans ce rôle clé, vous surveillez les risques de tiers et aidez PostFinance à être sûre et réussie même dans un environnement exigeant et dynamique. Vous obtiendrez un aperçu unique des principaux processus et sujets d'affaires de la banque et travaillerez avec des spécialistes et des cadres d'un large éventail de domaines. Particulièrement excitant : Le thème de la gestion des risques par des tiers est actuellement élargi. Cela vous donne l'occasion de façonner de nouveaux processus et de nouvelles normes et de façonner activement le développement de cette fonction. Si vous voulez analyser les risques complexes, prendre des responsabilités et travailler dans un environnement avec beaucoup d'indépendance et de créativité, nous sommes impatients de vous connaître.

Tu peux le faire.

- Dans le cadre du contrôle indépendant des risques (2e ligne), vous surveillez les risques et les contrôles dans le secteur des tiers et évaluez leur gestion appropriée.

- Assurer l'identification et l'évaluation des risques opérationnels et l'efficacité des contrôles pertinents dans le cadre du système de contrôle interne

- Vous analyserez les situations de risque complexes, formulerez des recommandations fondées et présenterez vos conclusions aux ministères, à la direction et aux comités spécialisés de façon appropriée.

- Vous développerez activement le suivi des tiers et établirez de nouveaux processus, méthodes et normes pour la gestion des risques des tiers orientée vers l'avenir

- Vous effectuerez des activités de surveillance axées sur les risques, comme la surveillance des risques financiers, médiatiques ou de concentration, les validations de diligence raisonnable et l'évaluation des rapports ISAE/SOC

- Vous préparez la base de la prise de décision pour la direction et le conseil d'administration et soutenez le développement de notre outil de gestion des risques ainsi que les évaluations basées sur les données

Apporte ça avec toi.

- Au moins cinq ans d'expérience professionnelle dans la gestion des risques par des tiers, l'externalisation de la gestion des risques, la gestion des risques opérationnels ou le système de contrôle interne (SCI)

- Achèvement d'une école technique supérieure, d'un collège de sciences appliquées ou d'une université, de préférence en administration des affaires, en gestion des risques, en droit ou dans une discipline comparable

- Fortes compétences analytiques et conceptuelles ainsi que la capacité de faire des évaluations solides de questions complexes

titleByLocale.fr: DevOps Ingénieur (w/m/d)

descriptionByLocale.it:

descriptionByLocale.en:
Do you want to actively shape modern DevOps practices, support our teams in stable and efficient delivery processes, contribute your cloud-native mindset and develop professionally? Then you are exactly right with us!

We are looking for a dedicated DevOps Engineer to support our teams with deep experience in automation, CI/CD and platform technologies. Together, we ensure that our customers’ bank transaction data is processed and provided in real time using modern technologies. You actively shape our DevOps landscape and contribute to stable, secure and efficient solutions.

You can do that.

- You continue to develop and operate our CI/CD pipelines and ensure that deployments are stable, efficient and traceable

- Support our two teams with automation, platform themes and operational processes so that developers can focus more on the development process

- You take responsibility for monitoring, stability and availability of our microservices and recognize optimization potential at an early stage

- You will actively contribute your experience in DevOps practices to the teams and our DevOps Guilde and promote continuous improvement, security and quality in our delivery processes

- With your knowledge, you strengthen cooperation between development and operations and help us provide sustainable and efficient solutions

You bring that with you

- Higher degree in Computer Science (FH or Uni) or equivalent professional experience

- Several years of experience in the DevOps environment as well as in the construction and operation of modern CI/CD pipelines with GitLab and Git.

- Very good knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes and microservice architecture.

- In-depth understanding of GitOps principles and their application with ArgoCD.

- Experience in infrastructure as code (customize, helmet, terraform) and declarative deployment strategies.

- Experience with monitoring, logging and observability solutions, such as Splunk and Grafana

- Knowledge of DevSecOps as well as experience with SonarQube and automated security and quality checks are beneficial.

- Experience in developing Java applications is an advantage

- Analytical and solution-oriented working methods as well as enthusiasm for modern technologies and continuous development.
descriptionByLocale.de:

descriptionByLocale.fr:

What you can do

- You will support the implementation of compliance risk analyses and the assessment of regulatory issues

- You will be involved in the monitoring and further development of the compliance framework and gain insights into control processes

- You will analyze facts, conduct research and prepare findings for various stakeholders in a way that is appropriate for the target group

- You will support the preparation of statements, reports and decision templates for departments and management

- You will be involved in the assessment of new regulatory requirements and support their implementation within PostFinance.

- You will be in contact with internal departments and learn about the interaction between compliance, risk management, legal and business

What you bring to the table

- You have a Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Law or Economics that was not more than two years ago at the start of the program or are at least in the 4th semester of your Bachelor's degree

- Interest in compliance, risk and governance issues in the financial services environment

descriptionByLocale.it:

Sei interessato ai mercati finanziari e vorresti mettere in pratica le conoscenze teoriche degli studi? Allora questa potrebbe essere un'opportunità entusiasmante per te! Nella gestione del rischio di PostFinance, siamo responsabili dei rischi finanziari del nostro bilancio. Cosa puoi fare

- Aiuterai a gestire uno dei più grandi bilanci bancari in Svizzera

- Ci supporterai nella gestione attiva dei rischi di tasso d'interesse e liquidità

- Hai un ruolo importante nello sviluppo ulteriore degli strumenti utilizzati

- Misurerai i rischi di tasso di interesse e liquidità utilizzando modelli esistenti, interpreterai i risultati e li preparerai

descriptionByLocale.en:

Are you interested in financial markets and would like to put your theoretical knowledge from your studies into practice? Then this could be an exciting opportunity for you! In PostFinance's risk management, we are responsible for the financial risks of our balance sheet. Our goal is to actively manage PostFinance's interest rate and liquidity risks. With us, you will learn the basic concepts and methods of risk management. Since we cover a wide range of topics, there are various opportunities to contribute and develop your skills with us, depending on your strengths and interests

What you can do

- You will help manage one of the largest bank balance sheets in Switzerland

- You will support us in actively managing interest rate and liquidity risks

- You have an important role in the further development of the tools used

- You will measure interest rate and liquidity risks using existing models, interpret the results and prepare them

What you bring to the table

- You have a bachelor's degree in physics, mathematics, computer science, engineering, economics or economics that was not more than two years ago at the start of the program or are at least in the 4th semester of your bachelor's degree

- Strong curiosity, great willingness to learn and the willingness to deal with economic issues

- Programming skills, for example in R

- Very good knowledge of German, other languages are an advantage
descriptionByLocale.de:

La sostenibilità non è solo una parola d'ordine per noi, ma una parte integrante del nostro lavoro quotidiano. Con la nuova strategia, abbiamo ancorato la sostenibilità come priorità centrale. Ora stiamo mettendo in pratica i nostri obiettivi!

Il nostro team interdisciplinare guida iniziative di sostenibilità, sviluppa concetti innovativi e plasma attivamente il cambiamento. Il focus? Modelli di business sostenibili e a prova di futuro nel settore bancario che combinano valori economici, ecologici e sociali.

- Sarai coinvolto nell'organizzazione e nello sviluppo di un workshop sull'innovazione della durata di diversi giorni, oltre ad altre iniziative e attività di supporto sulla sostenibilità per promuovere l'impegno e la consapevolezza della sostenibilità tra i dipendenti

descriptionByLocale.en:

Sustainability is not just a buzzword for us, but an integral part of our everyday work. With the new strategy, we have anchored sustainability as a central priority. Now we are putting our goals into practice!

Our interdisciplinary team drives sustainability initiatives, develops innovative concepts and actively shapes change. The focus? Future-proof, sustainable business models in banking that combine economic, ecological and social values.

What you can do

- You will support the further development and anchoring of the topic of digital ethics. To this end, you will accompany projects from various business areas, develop basic principles and tools and support the integration of digital ethical aspects into projects

- You will be involved in the organization and further development of an innovation workshop lasting several days as well as other sustainability initiatives and support activities to promote commitment and sustainability awareness among employees

- You will work closely with departments from across the company and gain insights into the diverse interfaces between sustainability, innovation, communication and other functions.

- You will take responsibility for your own work packages and support the sustainability team in projects, analyses and conceptual issues

What you bring to the table

- You have a bachelor's degree in business administration, sustainability management, communication or a comparable field that was not more than two years ago at the start of the program or are at least in the 4th semester of your bachelor's degree program

- Initial practical experience and interest in sustainability, education, digitization or digital ethics.

- Analytical thinking skills and the ability to prepare complex topics in a structured way and convey them in an understandable way

- Initiative, openness and enjoyment of working with different stakeholder groups

- Very good knowledge of German
descriptionByLocale.de:
Dauer Hochschulpraktikum: 1. Februar 2027 - 31. Juli 2027

Nachhaltigkeit ist für uns nicht nur ein Schlagwort, sondern ein fester Bestandteil unseres Arbeitsalltags. Mit der neuen Strategie haben wir Nachhaltigkeit als eine zentrale Priorität verankert. Jetzt setzen wir unsere Ziele in die Tat um!

- Du unterstützt die Weiterentwicklung und Verankerung des Themenfelds Digitalethik. Dazu begleitest du Vorhaben aus verschiedenen Geschäftsbereichen, erarbeitest Grundlagen sowie Hilfsmittel und unterstützt die Integration digitalethischer Aspekte in Projekte

- Du arbeitest eng mit Fachbereichen aus dem gesamten Unternehmen zusammen und erhältst Einblicke in die vielfältigen Schnittstellen zwischen Nachhaltigkeit, Innovation, Kommunikation und weiteren Funktionen.

- Du übernimmst Verantwortung für eigene Arbeitspakete und unterstützt das Nachhaltigkeitsteam bei Projekten, Analysen und konzeptionellen Fragestellungen

Das bringst du mit

- Du hast einen Bachelorabschluss in Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Nachhaltigkeitsmanagement, Kommunikation oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung, der bei Programmbeginn nicht länger als zwei Jahre zurückliegt oder befindest dich mindestens im 4. Semester deines Bachelorstudiums

descriptionByLocale.fr:

La durabilité n'est pas seulement un mot à la mode pour nous, mais une partie intégrante de notre travail quotidien. Avec cette nouvelle stratégie, nous avons ancré la durabilité comme priorité centrale. Nous mettons désormais nos objectifs en pratique !
